summary: Our app- 'Abandoned but not Forgotten'- allows people to explore various hardware used on the moon and mars. The first page take you to an image of each celestial body- you can click on one of them which will take you to a map of the one you selected. On each map, there will be pinpoints at different locations where each hardware landed and was used. Again, you can click on one of these pin points to show images and information about the selected hardware. This app will encourage young people to further their interest and understanding in space exploration. Being able to interact with and see the history of Rovers, Landers and Satellites launched by NASA can lead to more people holding excitement for future advances and events in space exploration.
